listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
listing.aiSummary: Increases vanilla bounty minimums and maximums by three times and adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties.

description: Increases vanilla bounty minimums and maximums by three times. Adds Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties. Includes functional scaling, 30-day durations, and numerous configuration sliders.
